mail.sign_in.subject: Your targum sign-in link
mail.sign_in.body:
Here is your link back into targum:

{link}

It works once, and it stops working in twenty minutes. If you did not ask for it,
nothing has happened to your account and you can ignore this.
reader.ask.label: Ask about this word
reader.card.found-nothing: we found nothing — write your own
reader.card.prefix-caveat: read as a prefix plus a word
reader.chapter.could-not-reach: We couldn't reach targum. Try again.
reader.chapter.could-not-start: We couldn't start that. Try again.
reader.error.conversation: We couldn't continue the conversation. Try again.
reader.finish.said: Finished. You'll see it on your progress page.
reader.first.keys: k known · 1 2 3 · {forward} next word · ? every key
reader.foot.stopped: Read here without a look-up, looked up before:
reader.page.close-this-then-a-word-then-: close this, then a word, then your saved words, then the queue
reader.page.drag-across-words-to-keep-a-: Drag across words to keep a phrase.
reader.page.each-verse-twice-in-hebrew-t: Each verse twice in Hebrew, then once in Onkelos
reader.page.forward-through-the-words-yo: forward through the words you have not finished with, then the foot of the page, then the next page — and, off the last, the next chapter; back through the words as they are written
reader.page.full-screen-and-out-of-it: full screen, and out of it
reader.page.highlight-the-words-you-have: Highlight the words you have not learned yet, and clear them as you mark them (m)
reader.page.highlight-what-you-have-not-: Highlight what you have not learned
reader.page.ignore-it-a-name-a-numeral-a: ignore it — a name, a numeral, a word from another language
reader.page.interlinear-the-translation-: interlinear — the translation under each line
reader.page.just-met-getting-there-nearl: just met, getting there, nearly there
reader.page.next-page-pageup-back-on-the: next page; PageUp back. On the last page, the next chapter
reader.page.open-on-youtube-at-this-line: Open on YouTube at this line
reader.page.our-dictionary-forms-are-les:
Our dictionary forms are less reliable on biblical Hebrew than
    on modern. The analyser learned from modern unpointed text, so it sometimes misreads
    waw-consecutive, pausal and archaic forms on a card.
reader.page.put-the-picture-in-a-corner: Put the picture in a corner
reader.page.show-every-word-in-one-case-: Show every word in one case (c)
reader.page.stress-marks-n-we-mark-a-wor: Stress marks (n). We mark a word only where two sources agree, so some words stay bare.
reader.page.take-back-the-last-level-and: take back the last level, and stand on that word again
reader.page.talk-to-targum-about-this-te: Talk to targum about this text
reader.page.tap-a-word-to-say-how-well: Tap a word to say how well you know it.
reader.page.tap-or-click-a-word-to-say: Tap or click a word to say how well you know it.
reader.page.the-chanting-marks-as-the-ma: The chanting marks, as the Masorah wrote them (a)
reader.page.the-chanting-marks-with-the-: the chanting marks, with the vowels on
reader.page.the-level-on-a-word-s-card: the level on a word's card says how common it is across the language; the number in the library says how much of a text will be new to you
reader.page.vowel-points-as-this-text-wr: Vowel points, as this text writes them (n)
reader.page.vowel-points-n-where-this-te: Vowel points (n). Where this text left a word bare, we guessed — about 90% right on modern Hebrew, less on classical. We mark the sentences we guessed.
reader.page.vowel-points-our-best-guess-: Vowel points, our best guess — about 90% right on modern Hebrew, less on classical (n)
reader.page.watch-it-full-screen-or-read: watch it full screen, or read alongside it with the picture in a corner
reader.page.what-the-word-you-are-on-mea: what the word you are on means; again to look it up
reader.page.what-you-have-kept-from-this: What you have kept from this text
reader.pick.in-parallel: word by word — the sentence is in parallel
reader.practice.every-verse: Every verse, twice in Hebrew and once in Onkelos
reader.rest.marked.one: You marked {n} words as known. Nothing left to mark here.
reader.rest.marked.other: You marked {n} words as known. Nothing left to mark here.
reader.rest.names-too: We clear names and numbers too, without counting them.
